topic.title: Your year's pay against Ronaldo's Forbes-estimated year: per day, per minute, and how many of your years his one takes

title: You work all year for this. He does it before breakfast ⚽
description:
Is a whole year's pay big money? Not next to Cristiano Ronaldo.
Cristiano Ronaldo's $300M year, as Forbes estimates it, cut into days and minutes and set against one salary.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Guess how long it takes you? Comment

lines.text: You think a salary's a fortune? Not to Ronaldo.
Forbes estimates that Ronaldo made $300M in a single year.
That pile grows every single week, whether he plays or not.
But every minute, more lands, even while he's asleep.
So on $60,000 a year, how long would you need?
5,000 years of steady work, to match one of his.
And your whole year's pay? He makes it before breakfast.
